structured_output.summary: The wire chunk remains minimal and well evidenced. profiles.rs changes exactly two request-schema arguments (lines 91, 214) with frozen response roots and unchanged operation ids, proven byte-exactly against baseline 578f2e6. Directional wire tests cover create/update/list_for_token/list/get/paged list_all under both response policies, pre-auth rejection of 5 pointers x 3 invalid values (token.calls 0, wire.requests 0), raw-extension round-trips and lossless null/unsupported responses. All 107 recorded checks exit 0 on the reviewed source e30c4d3b, executed in one 09:18-09:35 run, including both compilers, the executed example and the dependency audit ordered first. All three attempt-3 lows are fixed with regressions. Only two documentation/binding lows remain.

findings.description: The current section says the receipt "qualifies the directional-profile implementation source" and then lists unqualified workflows (Vertex AI, N8N, client-session, audio, realtime) without naming directional profile create/update. The receipt only verified oauth.get_token plus four 403 target-list probes. CHANGELOG.md:40, docs/STABILITY.md:51 and docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:5-7 state directional live acceptance is unverified, but the live-acceptance page itself does not, and tools/test_live_acceptance_docs.py:25-34 does not require it.
findings.required_fix: State in the current read-only section that directional profile create/update remain live-unverified, and assert that sentence in tools/test_live_acceptance_docs.py.

findings.description: The attempt-3 fix added the four directional wire tests to ProfilesClient.create (line 628) and ProfilesClient.update (line 772), but the read rows the same tests exercise - listForToken (line 756), list and the get helper - still bind only profile_methods_match_literal_routes_schemas_defaults_and_helpers, even though directional_profiles_preserve_all_wire_paths_and_both_response_policies and profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options qualify their directional response handling (crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs:1772-1836, 1993-2041). tools/test_typescript035_profiles.py:26-31 asserts the binding only for create/update.
findings.required_fix: Add the two directional read-path test references to the listForToken/list/get rows in contracts/native-operation-mappings/management.json, regenerate native-operations.json and qualification.json, and extend the assertion in tools/test_typescript035_profiles.py.

evidence: crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/management/profiles.rs:91,214 are the only changed schema arguments ("typescript:0.35.0:CreateSecurityProfileRequestSchema"); response roots at 76,92,107,215,231 and all .named() ids are untouched. tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:67-76 proves this byte-exactly against baseline 578f2e6 (before.count==2, after.count==2, after.replace(current,previous)==before, identical .named() lists).

crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs:1735-1839 drives POST /v1/mgmt/profile, PUT /v1/mgmt/profile/uuid/{id}, list_for_token, list, get and a 2-page list_all for defaults true and false against a directional fixture whose reply carries null dlp_tenant_id, integer tool-call and null enable-full-conversation-inspection, asserting byte-equal serde round-trips; this proves the response root stays tolerant on the real wire path.

crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs:1842-1872 drives 5 JSON pointers x 3 invalid values (null, 17, array) through create and update asserting ErrorKind::Validation with token.calls==0 and wire.requests==0; lines 1876-1982 prove raw .extension() requests serialize identically and decode into typed projections, including nested tool-response app-protection.

crates/scm-sdk/tests/typescript035_models.rs:20-88 replays contracts/typescript-035-oracle.json (sourceCommit 780c985c...) for all 8 roots with per-root acceptance/rejection requirements and typed round-trips; lines 90-140 prove omission/null/unsupported response values and nested fallback stay lossless in both response modes; 198-213 proves the versioned list default under all three modes.

Command set includes verify_typescript035_source, typescript035_profiles --check, typescript035-oracle --check plus tsc --strict, generate_models/generate_validation/response_defaults --check, native_operations/native_exports/qualification --check, live_evidence --check, red_team_management --check --current-source-compatibility, and check-dependencies ordered before the first check-rust.

Receipt lines 2958-3021 record scripts/check-rust.py on 1.89.0 and 1.99.0 for the management feature set with fmt, check, clippy -D warnings, test, test --examples, doc and cargo run --example directional_profiles all exit 0; docs/checks/phase-27-rust-1.99.0-management.json:140-150 shows the example's actual stdout "Directional typed models and lossless response compatibility verified offline."

Attempt-3 low 1 fixed: contracts/native-operation-mappings/management.json:628-633 and 772-777 now list all four directional wire tests on create/update, bound by tools/test_typescript035_profiles.py:21-31 together with the honest Request-only oracleScope assertions.

Attempt-3 low 2 fixed: tools/test_management_phases.py:122-128 now iterates range(21, 28) and additionally asserts :(exclude)contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/* for every phase-27 git diff --check command; the receipt's first checks (lines 9-26) carry that exclusion.

Attempt-3 low 3 fixed: docs/PHASES.md:283-289 adds an explicit phase-27 acceptance paragraph naming red_team_management.py --check --current-source-compatibility, the fresh current-source bounded read-only receipt, and the deliberate phase-28 deferral of clean extracted package consumers.

Dependency advisories: Cargo.lock:1122-1124 and 1772-1774 plus contracts/native-probes/Cargo.lock carry rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.10; tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:90-110 proves only those two packages changed version/checksum and that the audit precedes the Rust matrix; docs/checks/phase-27-dependencies.json reports passed true with vulnerabilities found false over 206 packages and freshHead true.

Honest live scoping: contracts/live-evidence.json points at docs/checks/phase-27-live-attempt-05.json (schemaVersion 2, read-only, mutationsEnabled false, 1 verified OAuth probe, four 403 permission_prerequisite probes) and tools/live_evidence.py:301,313-315 require the runtime fingerprint over crates/scm-sdk/src plus examples and the endpoint-profile limitation for phase 27/28 receipts; tools/red_team_management.py:798-819 rejects a stale receipt or inflated live counts, and contracts/native-exports.json:54-62 reports liveVerified 1 of 3820.

Security posture preserved: crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs:13484-13488 and 13600-13604 redact Debug for both new types; 4514-4559 shows typed-wins serialization applies only to the two projection keys while the baseline KNOWN collision error is unchanged; 4467-4512 keeps unrepresentable values in extensions; crates/scm-sdk/tests/schema_contracts.rs:9-52 still proves the 23 frozen defaults under both response policies and that the single new alias s_ts035_s009653 equals s009653; crates/scm-sdk/Cargo.toml:83-85 gates the example behind required-features = ["management"], asserted by tools/test_ci.py:515-519.

Documentation states both validation directions: CHANGELOG.md:17-28, docs/STABILITY.md:36-48 and docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:97-123 disclose the intentional request tightening, the frozen tolerant response path, typed-over-extension precedence and the unchanged list default; contracts/typescript-035-management-compatibility.json separates historical from current source bindings without representing old hashes as current execution.
limitations: Read-only review: I could not run git, cargo or the phase driver, so exit codes, test counts, timestamps and source fingerprints come from docs/reviews/phase-27-chunk-wire-and-compatibility-attempt-04.checks.json and docs/checks/phase-27-rust-*-management.json rather than re-execution.

I recomputed no SHA-256; parity-ledger sourceBindings, native-exports/qualification digests, the Cargo.lock hash shared with the Rust receipts, and the live receipt digest rest on the recorded passing owner checks.

I did not verify that the 107 recorded commands are literally equal to commands_for(27); review_phase.check_evidence enforces that equality at record time and the receipt reports passed true with all exit codes 0.
Directional create/update were never exercised against a tenant; the current receipt covers only OAuth token exchange and four 403 probes on a non-default endpoint profile.

Clean extracted package-consumer builds are deliberately excluded from commands_for(27) (tools/check_phase.py:319-324; management_consumers reports executionClaimed false). That is phase 28 scope and I did not judge it.

I reviewed only the wire-and-compatibility chunk. Generated model and validation correctness was judged through the two compilers, selected generated declarations (generated.rs:4456-4560, 13369-13604) and the independent oracle/fixture checks, not a full audit of models-and-validation.
I read neither .local/typescript nor any credential or tenant-registration material; contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0 as pinned was treated as the authoritative upstream input.

The new request roots reject null/wrong-type values the old passthrough accepted. The plan authorizes this and CHANGELOG/STABILITY disclose it in both directions, so I treated it as a recorded maintainer decision, not a finding.
